blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — PNB Holdings Corp. (PHC) is looking to spend hundreds of millions—or potentially billions—of pesos to repurpose parts of its property portfolio after its stock market debut, pursuing growth while holding off on costlier redevelopment projects. PHC chief financial officer Ponciano Carreon Jr. told reporters that the company would disclose within the next three to six months which properties or spaces would undergo adaptive reuse.
